{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: CI
on:
    push:
        branches:
            - trunk
    pull_request:

jobs:
    lint-and-typecheck:
        name: 'Lint and typecheck'
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v3
            - uses: ./.github/actions/prepare-playground
            - run: npx nx affected --target=lint
            - run: npx nx affected --target=typecheck

            - name: Install PHP
              uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
              with:
                  php-version: '7.4'
                  extensions: mbstring, zip, pdo_mysql

            - name: Install Composer dependencies
              run: composer install

            - name: Run PHPCS
              run: vendor/bin/phpcs
    test:
        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
        timeout-minutes: 5
        needs: [lint-and-typecheck]
        steps:
            - uses: actions/checkout@v3
            - uses: ./.github/actions/prepare-playground
            - run: npx nx affected --target=test --configuration=ci", "rationale": "The workflow's two jobs (lint-and-typecheck and test) have no timeout-minutes set, so a hung step can consume runner time indefinitely. Pattern P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by a measured CI workflow experiment on a fork (evidence_scope: measured_ci_workflow_on_fork) in which adding timeout-minutes: 5 reduced median elapsed time from 41s to 30s (26.8% savings) while all runs still succeeded. Repository CI history shows successful runs completing in roughly 1-4 minutes, so a 5-minute bound provides operational headroom without tripping on valid slow runs (the pattern's contraindication is that valid slow runs exceed the limit, which history does not indicate). The change only adds timeout-minutes: 5 to both jobs; every existing step, dependency, and required check is preserved, so build and test coverage is unchanged. No new network access, secrets, privileged actions, or deployment operations are introduced.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]}
